verdict.rationale: Lithic explicitly documents agentic use cases: its blog walks through creating a virtual card for an agent, configuring Authorization Rules for merchant category/transaction limits/velocity, and testing against those rules, and its agentic-commerce solutions page markets 'secure and autonomous issuing, payments, and controls for AI-powered workflows.' Card creation supports virtual cards, spend limits, and MCC/country/currency-based Authorization Rules at the card level, and expiry is a standard card attribute. missing for 10: a single named end-to-end example combining merchant lock + amount cap + expiry specifically framed as 'issuing a card to an agent' in one document, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs/blog.
